description: FED于1988年推出的立体相机。快门速度leaf shutter with speeds 1/30 to 1/650 sec. plus B (B only in manual mode)。使用35mm (around 20 image pairs on one film possible)。

specs.胶片/画幅: 35mm (around 20 image pairs on one film possible)
specs.快门: leaf shutter with speeds 1/30 to 1/650 sec. plus B (B only in manual mode)
specs.光圈: 2.8 to 14 in automatic and 2.8 to 16 in manual mode
